text:
Marisa Kim: Weekly health check — NovaHealth (hosted). Quick summary: monthly commit $15,000. Current 7-day burn = $22,400 (149% of weekly pro‑rata). Latency and error rates normal; main anomaly = embed spikes on 3/16 causing heavy token/embedding unit usage. Flagging as spend anomaly and potential renewal watch.

billing-bot: ALERT created — spend_anomaly:NOVA-3102 — 3/16 09:15 UTC. Peak hourly spend +380% vs baseline. (See: https://redwood.internal/billing/alerts/NOVA-3102)

Javier Lopez: Yikes. Do we know which route/model caused the spike? Customer on a $15k commit; this eats margin fast. :eyes:

Priya Choudhary: Looking now — running quick breakdown by endpoint and route. Will paste query.

Priya Choudhary: ```sql
-- hourly spend by endpoint for NovaHealth
SELECT endpoint, SUM(tokens_used*cost_per_token) as cost, hour
FROM billing.events
WHERE customer_id='nova_health' AND ts >= '2026-03-15'::date
GROUP BY endpoint,hour
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

Priya Choudhary: Early pickup: /v1/embeddings/text-embed-large (hosted) accounted for ~88% of spike. Batch size and concurrency were unusually high around 09:12 UTC.

Alex Nguyen: Traced job: profile_recompute_v2 (customer-side scheduled job) called our hosted embeddings endpoint instead of Dedicated. It appears their infra misconfigured the SDK key — used hosted key. We have logs: 09:11–09:35 UTC ~ 1.2M embeddings.

Marisa Kim: Action items: 1) Applied temporary per-route quota (embeddings) for NovaHealth to limit burst. 2) Created incident ticket CS-1127 to revert costs and notify finance for potential credit. 3) Scheduled enablement call to review routing keys and SDK best practices. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket CS-1127 created — assigned to Priya and Alex. SLA: 48h.

Javier Lopez: I'll loop in NovaHealth CTO and propose a short-term commit top-up or commit reprofile to avoid renewal risk. Can you share expected weekly baseline post-mitigation?

Priya Choudhary: Baseline projection after quota + rerouting to Dedicated pool: ~ $3.5k/week (from current $22.4k), so monthly ~ $14k — roughly back to commit. I'll attach the chart in the ticket.

Alex Nguyen: Also adding a server-side safeguard: when embeddings batch >128 or concurrency>10 for hosted keys, auto-throttle and emit warning. Will PR the guard today.

Marisa Kim: Great. I'll notify customer + set renewal risk flag to "watch" for this week and update next week's health report. Meeting invite sent for Mon 10am PT.

Javier Lopez: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread and CS-1127. If finance needs numbers for credits ping me.

Marisa Kim: Closing the loop here — will post final post-mortem in #customer-success after CS-1127 resolves. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
